method: Conditional Monte Carlo: shuffled shoes, first k cards dealt (k uniform up to a 70% cut card), every two-card hand and the upcard enumerated with their dealing probabilities, exact action EVs from the true remaining composition, grouped by the observable Hi-Lo true count (visible running count ÷ quarter-deck estimate of cards in the shoe). Buckets −6..+8 with 160 states each, refined to 640 states around crossings; a bucket is resolved when the best play's margin exceeds two clustered standard errors.
